hook.rumour: Every wool-factor between Chorrol and Battlehorn has dropped the Fighters Guild for a cheap broker wearing an ash-grey seal—and any shepherd who refuses wakes up to goblins in his fold.
hook.notice: CHORROL FIGHTERS GUILD HALL: Sellswords and investigators wanted beneath the Great Oak to look into the staged goblin raids on the Colovian wool-runs.

stages.objective: Review the cancelled shepherd-escort contracts at the Chorrol Fighters Guild hall
Inspect the burned wool-wagons outside Battlehorn Castle and question the drovers
Bring the painted goblin-totem splinter back to the Guild steward in Chorrol

objectives.text: Review the cancelled shepherd-escort contracts at the Chorrol Fighters Guild hall

consequence_detail.summary: The goblin-totem splinter found at Battlehorn Castle is freshly cut with an Imperial carpenter's saw, proving the raids were baited.

stages.objective: Follow the sawdust trail south from Chorrol toward the ridge above Fort Carmala
Drive off the hired totem-planters at Fort Carmala and seize their route-map
Trace the wagon-ruts to the timber depot near Hackdirt

objectives.text: Follow the sawdust trail south from Chorrol toward the ridge above Fort Carmala
Drive off the hired totem-planters at Fort Carmala and seize their route-map
Trace the wagon-ruts to the timber depot near Hackdirt

consequence_detail.summary: The route-map from Fort Carmala shows the raids are coordinated from a fortified counting-house at Fort Ash.

stages.objective: Question the teamsters outside Hackdirt about the night shipments to Fort Ash
Infiltrate the outer court of Fort Ash and recover the double-entry wool and mercenary ledger
Present the ledger to Countess Valga's herald and the Fighters Guild steward in Chorrol

objectives.text: Question the teamsters outside Hackdirt about the night shipments to Fort Ash

Present the ledger to Countess Valga's herald and the Fighters Guild steward in Chorrol

consequence_detail.summary: The ledger proves an Elder Council factor named Mallius Varro has been subsidising Blackwood recruiters to corner Colovian wool.

stages.objective: Storm the keep of Fort Ash and defeat Provost Mallius Varro's mercenary company
Recover the stolen Colovian Wool-Staple Charter and Council of Ash correspondence
Convene the Great Oak Assize in Chorrol to restore the Fighters Guild's highland contracts

consequence_detail.summary: Beneath the Great Oak of Chorrol, the wool-estates and loggers sign a mutual peace and renew the Fighters Guild charter.
